description: The R package epanetReader reads INP and RPT network files and provides summaries and plots for subsequent analysis. This resource is provided by bradleyjeck (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: It reads and analyses model files; it is not itself the EPANET hydraulic solver. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
